title.narrative: Improving Transparency & Accountability in the province of Santa Fe

description.narrative: "The overall objective of the proposed IDF grant is improving the transparency and accountability of sub-national public institutions in Argentinain the province of Santa Fe by supporting the implementation of the recently approved Access to Information (ATI) norm (Decree 0692/09) in the province of Santa Fe. The grant will also aim at promoting cross-fertilization with other Argentinean provinces. By supporting the implementation of ATI, the proposal aims at developing a ""performance enclave"" in the province of Santa Fe that can have demonstration effects for other provinces willing to work on this area in the future. Santa Fe's governor, Hermes Binner, has become a champion for good governance and has a track record of state modernization reforms. The proposal tries to take advantage of this window of opportunity, and ultimately, to promote a broader movement in support of transparency and accountability at the sub-national level that could eventually permeate the federal level in Argentina. Specific Objectives: 1. Strengthening the Direccion Provincial de Anticorrupcion y Transparencia's (Anticorruption and Transparency Provincial Directorate) oversight role through facilitating access to ATI peer knowledge and regional good practices, and supporting capacity building activities. 2. Supporting the capacity for implementation of information requests handling, as well as pro-active transparency provisions of the newly approved ATI legislation in Santa Fe province, through the development of ICT platforms. 3. Developing and testing a tracking and reporting system to facilitate monitoring of implementation. 4. Strengthening the network of access to information officials and experts at the sub-national level and facilitating cross-fertilization between the most advanced provinces and the ones starting in this area The overall objective of the proposed IDF grant is improving the transparency and accountability in the province of Santa Fe by supporting the implementation of the recently approved Access to Information (ATI) norm (Decree 0692/09). 1.
